Hi Sofia — great to hear Nov 10 works. Logistics and next steps below (please share final headcount by Nov 3):

Badging & entry:
- Pre-registration: Please reply to this thread with full legal names and a government ID type for each attendee by Nov 3. We will pre-print badges.
- Pickup: On arrival, report to Reception (main lobby). Reception will have a pre-printed badge stack under "Veridian Partners". If anyone arrives early, they can get a temporary visitor badge after presenting ID.
- Escort: For security-sensitive areas we require an escort. For the workshop floor we will have an escort available between 09:15–15:30.

Parking & vehicle:
- Reserved delivery spot: Yes — Van may use Loading Dock A (enter on Market St). Please provide license plate and ETA; we will hold the spot between 08:00–16:00.
- Visitor parking: One reserved visitor spot adjacent to the lobby; additional parking is meter-based.

Rooms & AV:
- Primary: Conference B (4th floor) — projector, USB‑C HDMI, whiteboard.
- Breakouts: Rooms B1 and B2 adjacent to Conference B (capacity 6 each).
- AV contact: Ethan Park, ethan.park@redwood.ai, 415-555-0123. If you need a dongle, let us know model and we will bring adapters.

Networking & laptops:
- Guest Wi‑Fi SSID: Redwood-Guest. No device enrollment required; network is segmented from internal infra. Outbound access is unrestricted for typical dev traffic but our security reviewer will share a short acceptable use policy.
- Personal laptops: Allowed for hands-on. If you require managed images we can provision a local VM image — tell us OS requirements.

Catering:
- Lunch will be boxed lunches (vegetarian and gluten-free options available). Please reply with dietary restrictions by Nov 3.

Attachments for reference:
- redwood-visitor-nda.docx (please sign via DocuSign if your legal prefers)
